name: Horizon Europe: Living Labs for the eradication and/or management of invasive alien species
summary: Horizon Europe funding for consortia that run living labs of 10 to 20 field sites each, with practitioners and local communities, to detect, eradicate or manage invasive alien species in at least three EU Member States or Associated Countries.

geography.label: Living labs in at least three EU Member States and/or Horizon Europe Associated Countries

amount.note: Around EUR 8 million per project; proposals may request other amounts

reporting: Consortia submit a periodic report for each reporting period, tied to interim payments, and a final report at the end of the project that sets the final grant amount.

eligibility.rule: Project focuses exclusively on civil applications
Has stable and sufficient resources to implement the project and contribute its share
Is not subject to EU administrative sanctions or grant exclusion situations
Is not subject to EU restrictive measures
Qualifying institutions have a gender equality plan at grant signature

co_finance_required.quote: The maximum Horizon Europe funding rates are as follows: - Research and innovation action: 100%

consortium_required.quote: at least one independent legal entity established in a Member State; and - at least two other independent legal entities, each established in different Member States or Associated Countries.

reporting.quote: There will be one or several interim payments linked to a periodic report, depending on the duration of the project. At the end of the project, the consortium will be invited to submit a report on the basis of which the final grant amount will be calculated.

eligibility.quote: Applications for projects that have already been completed will be rejected.
Projects must focus exclusively on civil applications
Applicants must have stable and sufficient resources to successfully implement the projects and contribute their share.
Applicants that are subject to EU administrative sanctions (i.e. exclusion)39 or are in one of the following exclusion situations 40 that bar them from receiving EU grants can NOT participate:

Entities subject to EU restrictive measures under Article 29 of the Treaty on the European Union (TEU) and Article 215 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the EU (TFEU)25 as well as Article 75 TFEU26, are not eligible to participate in any capacity

Member States and Associated Countries that are public bodies, research organisations or higher education establishments (including private research organisations and private higher education establishments) applying as beneficiaries or affiliated entities must have at the moment of grant signature and during the duration of the grant a gender equality plan
